data.body:
Fix pushed for review as Gerrit change 3033 ("Decide the benign-422 downgrade
with builtins").

Gate evidence before push:
- `make lint` clean, including zizmor and actionlint over the modified workflow.
- `make typecheck` clean.
- `make verify` full suite: 20,384 passed. 17 failed, ALL in
  `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/` wiki/pandoc rendering, and all pre-existing
  environment faults rather than repository evidence: the venv-vendored pandoc
  is an x86_64 Mach-O binary on an arm64 host, so it aborts with
  `OSError: [Errno 86] Bad CPU type in executable`. The identical 17 fail in a
  separate worktree that does NOT carry this change (17 failed, 55 passed in
  those three modules). CI runs x86_64 Linux, where these pass — run
  35925955245 showed none of them.
- The seven tests covering the re-dispatch step, including the new oracle, all
  pass; the new oracle is RED on the pre-fix workflow and GREEN after.
